decisions.summary: Add a read-only policy promotion ledger so learning governance can promote lessons into candidate_policy, policy, gate_candidate, gate, or retired states with owner, evidence, acceptance criteria, rollback, tests, and schema-backed checks.

verification_commands.expected: status pass with at least one gate promotion, at least one retired promotion, and irreversible_actions 0
stage receipts include the P29 release receipt and remain read-only by default
registry accepts the P29 work item and P29 release receipt_ref
focused P29 policy promotion and integration tests pass

observed_results.summary: P29 adds a policy promotion ledger document, committed promotion records for gate and retirement paths, a schema-backed read-only promotion gate, CI/package-index integration, and a P29 work item with stage receipt evidence.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step, package-index refs, policy promotion docs/records, and P29 work-item/receipt if the ledger blocks valid governance work; follow up with an organization score gate that computes maturity from evidence.
